appliesTo: the frontend's HTML responses and every API response (one sample per endpoint in scope); always runs

checks.expect: present; no 'unsafe-inline' for scripts; default-src or script-src restricted
present (recommended; reported as a recommendation if missing)
present with max-age >= 15552000 (skipped on plain http dev servers)
not '*' together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; matches the documented CORS decision

checks.on: any cookie carrying a session or token
checks.expect: HttpOnly; Secure (on https); SameSite=Lax or Strict

errors: Force a 404 and a 400 on each API in scope: the body must not contain stack traces, file paths or framework/version names.
fix: Add a security-headers middleware (e.g. helmet for Express) with an explicit CSP; disable X-Powered-By; return generic error bodies in production.
